Archomancy: The Archaian Magic System

Archomancy is a variant arcane magic system practiced by the ancient Archaians and the undead Archons of the Trium. A magic-user or illusionist of 5th level or higher who speaks Ancient Archaian may learn its precepts from ancient Archaian texts or from the Mystic Jewel of Koweewah (requires a successful Intelligence check, or 4–8 weeks of devoted study).

Calculating Spell Points

An Archomancer remains bound by standard daily spell slots per level, but converts their total daily spell capacity into a pool of Spell Points equal to the sum of (Spells per Day × Spell Level) across all spell levels they can cast.

Spell Level Example (10th-Level MU: 3/3/3/3/2) Spell Points
1st3 × 13
2nd3 × 26
3rd3 × 39
4th3 × 412
5th2 × 510
Total Pool—40 Spell Points

Casting any standard spell deducts its Spell Level in Spell Points (e.g., casting Fireball costs 3 Spell Points and expends one 3rd-level slot).

Spell Point Metamagic Effects

  • Cast Instantly (20 Spell Points): The spell resolves as the very first action in the combat round regardless of initiative. The caster cannot cast a spell on the following round.
  • Max Dice (50 Spell Points): Deals maximum damage per die up to 10 dice (any dice beyond 10 are rolled normally). The caster cannot cast a spell for the next two rounds.
  • Extra Dice (5 Spell Points / die): Adds +1 damage die to the spell.
  • Broaden Effect (5 Spell Points / 10 ft.): Expands the spell's area of effect by 10 feet.
  • Lengthen Effect (5 Spell Points / round): Extends the spell's duration by 1 round.
  • Dual-Casting (25 Spell Points): Cast two spells simultaneously (must be declared prior to initiative). Spells between levels 1–4 must be at least 2 levels apart; spells between levels 5–9 must be 3 levels apart; spells spanning 1–9 must be 4 levels apart.

Overchanneling (Negative Spell Points)

Casters may push their Spell Point pool into negative values down to a maximum of -10. Each negative point permanently drains 2 hit points and 1 point from every ability score. If any ability score drops below 0, the caster detonates in a burst of raw arcane energy, creating a permanent 300 ft. × 300 ft. Magic Dead zone.
